newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise margin fees on palladium futures.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise margin fees on palladium futures.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday that it would raise margin requirements on all its palladium futures by 30,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Tuesday.

The increase will bring the total margin requirement on the June palladium contract to 111,000 yen, while the margin fees on other palladium futures will be raised to 84,000 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The rise was intended to cool overheated trade.
